svg.aria-label: The knot tables: a pinch move on a trefoil; the nonorientable four-genus settled for 2,537 of 3,525 open knots, 444 in the fourth pass with 382 lower bounds from Donaldson's theorem; the bridge index settled for 243 of 536, with the walls the pass met

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A pinch gives an upper bound, checked in Regina; Donaldson's theorem on the Goeritz lattices gives a lower bound. Where they meet, the entry is settled.
